summary: Dublin, Ireland, member of TOG Hackerspace, strong interest in open-source software, expertise in programming and software development, critical of corporate practices, advocate for user rights and privacy, engaged in discussions about internet freedom and data ownership, interest in Linux and FLOSS (Free/Libre and Open Source Software), familiarity with A/B testing and statistical analysis, experience with email server setup (Postfix, Dovecot), interest in mapping technologies (OpenStreetMap), critical of DRM and corporate monopolies, awareness of EU regulations and labor rights.
